title: The Seven Champions of Christendom
author: William Henry Giles Kingston
description: "The Seven Champions of Christendom" by William Henry Giles Kingston is a whimsical novel likely written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The story focuses on the adventures of seven legendary champions, each representing a different country: England, Scotland, Ireland, Wales, France, Italy, and Spain.

authorInfo.bio: William Henry Giles Kingston (1814–1880) wrote The Seven Champions of Christendom. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.
